formal_definitions.name: VersionScopeValid
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev VersionScopeValid (g : Graph) (e : Assertion) : Prop :=
  match e.kind, e.qualifiers with
  | .conformsTo, .conformance scope ver evidence =>
      ver = e.target.version ∧ ∃ a ∈ g.assessments,
        a.ref = evidence ∧ a.mode = .conformance ∧ a.accepted = true ∧
        a.subject = e.source ∧ a.target = e.target ∧ a.scope = scope
  | .declaresEffectOn, .effect _ ver => ver = e.target.version
  | .materializesConsequence, .materialization receipt role digest =>
      (∃ t ∈ g.nodes, t.ref = e.target ∧ t.contentIdentity = digest) ∧
      ∃ a ∈ g.assessments, a.ref = receipt ∧ a.mode = .applicationReceipt ∧
        a.accepted = true ∧ a.subject = e.source ∧ a.target = e.target ∧
        a.role = role ∧ a.outputDigest = digest
  | _, _ => False
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain exact endpoint/version/evidence equalities and local identity uniqueness. A valid candidate edge need not be a member; a graph observation requires membership.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Checks exact target version and relation-specific accepted assessment/receipt bindings.

formal_definitions.name: groundInstances

def groundInstances (T : Theory) : List GroundInstance :=
  T.rules.flatMap fun r => (choices T.domain r.variables.length).filterMap (groundRule T r)
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain independent validity, enumeration completeness, saturation and no-extra-fact evidence. Partial execution cannot issue nonderivability or complete readiness.

formal_definitions.name: Saturated
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev Saturated (T : Theory) (C : List Atom) : Prop :=
  ∀ i ∈ groundInstances T, (∀ a ∈ i.body, a ∈ C) → i.head ∈ C
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain independent validity, enumeration completeness, saturation and no-extra-fact evidence. Partial execution cannot issue nonderivability or complete readiness.

formal_definitions.meaning: Every grounded rule instance whose body is present has its head present.

formal_definitions.name: ClosureValid
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev ClosureValid (T : Theory) (F C : List Atom) (certificates : List (List Step)) : Prop :=
  TheoryValid T ∧ InitialValid T F ∧ C.Nodup ∧ (∀ a ∈ C, AtomValid T a) ∧
  (∀ a ∈ F, a ∈ C) ∧ Saturated T C ∧
  ∀ a ∈ C, ∃ steps ∈ certificates, checkDerivation T F steps a = true
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain independent validity, enumeration completeness, saturation and no-extra-fact evidence. Partial execution cannot issue nonderivability or complete readiness.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: A unique typed candidate closure contains seeds, is saturated and has proof certificates for every member.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Both missing facts and extra unsupported facts must be excluded.

formal_definitions.name: checkClosure
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
def checkClosure (T : Theory) (F C : List Atom) (certificates : List (List Step)) : Bool :=
  decide (ClosureValid T F C certificates)
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain independent validity, enumeration completeness, saturation and no-extra-fact evidence. Partial execution cannot issue nonderivability or complete readiness.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Decides full exact closure validity with per-fact certificates.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: An accepted result permits scoped nonderivability; a partial or exhausted run does not.

formal_definitions.name: enabled
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
def enabled (current remaining : List Atom) (i : GroundInstance) : Bool :=
  decide (i.head ∈ remaining ∧ i.head ∉ current ∧ ∀ a ∈ i.body, a ∈ current)
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain independent validity, enumeration completeness, saturation and no-extra-fact evidence. Partial execution cannot issue nonderivability or complete readiness.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: An instance head is pending/not current and all premises are current.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Its finite progress measure operates on atoms, not duplicate support multiplicity.

formal_definitions.name: saturateFuel
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
def saturateFuel (instances : List GroundInstance) :
    Nat → List Atom → List Atom → Option (List Atom)
  | 0, current, remaining =>
      match instances.find? (enabled current remaining) with
      | none => some current
      | some _ => none
  | fuel + 1, current, remaining =>
      match instances.find? (enabled current remaining) with
      | none => some current
      | some i => saturateFuel instances fuel (current ++ [i.head]) (remaining.erase i.head)
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain independent validity, enumeration completeness, saturation and no-extra-fact evidence. Partial execution cannot issue nonderivability or complete readiness.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Adds enabled pending heads until none remain or supplied fuel ends.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Incomplete result must remain unknown; pending universe completeness matters.

formal_definitions.name: saturate
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
def saturate (instances : List GroundInstance) (current remaining : List Atom) : List Atom :=
  (saturateFuel instances remaining.length current remaining).getD []
formal_definitions.analysis: getD [] is covered by the sufficient-fuel theorem for this exact fuel choice. Do not reuse that default as a general timeout policy.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Uses pending-inventory length as sufficient fuel and returns the resulting saturation.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: The proof covers this exact fuel contract; getD [] is not a safe timeout interpretation.

formal_definitions.name: RequiredClosureAdequacy
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev RequiredClosureAdequacy : Prop :=

    checkClosure T F C certificates = true → ∀ a, a ∈ C ↔ Derivable T F a

formal_definitions.name: Rooted
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev Rooted (T : Theory) (a : Atom) : Prop :=
  ∃ p ∈ T.predicates, p.key = a.predicate ∧ rootedRole p.role = true

formal_definitions.name: Justification
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev Justification (T : Theory) (a : Atom) : Prop :=
  ∃ p ∈ T.predicates, p.key = a.predicate ∧ (p.role = .checkedRoot ∨ p.role = .rootCarrier)

formal_definitions.name: SafeGround
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev SafeGround (T : Theory) (i : GroundInstance) : Prop :=

formal_definitions.meaning: A rooted head has an exact same-tuple root justification in its body.

formal_definitions.name: SafeRules
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt: abbrev SafeRules (T : Theory) : Prop := ∀ i ∈ groundInstances T, SafeGround T i

def checkLineage (T : Theory) (F : List Atom) : Bool :=

formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev RequiredProtectedLineage : Prop :=

formal_definitions.analysis: Retain exact four-coordinate independent-root lineage. Sealed source observations need an orthogonal producer policy; ordinary information cannot supply new roots.

formal_definitions.name: ModelValid
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev ModelValid (T : Theory) (F M : List Atom) : Prop :=
  TheoryValid T ∧ InitialValid T F ∧ InitialValid T M ∧
    (∀ a ∈ F, a ∈ M) ∧ Saturated T M
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain actual checked witnesses. A finite model may contain extra truths beyond least closure; non-entailment refutes one implication and is not universal falsity.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: A typed/root-respecting finite inventory contains seeds and is saturated.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Unlike least closure, it may contain additional truths.

formal_definitions.name: checkModel
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt: def checkModel (T : Theory) (F M : List Atom) : Bool := decide (ModelValid T F M)
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain actual checked witnesses. A finite model may contain extra truths beyond least closure; non-entailment refutes one implication and is not universal falsity.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Decides finite model validity against exact theory and seeds.

formal_definitions.name: Countermodel
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev Countermodel (T : Theory) (F M : List Atom) (premise conclusion : Atom) : Prop :=
  ModelValid T F M ∧ AtomValid T premise ∧ AtomValid T conclusion ∧
    premise ∈ M ∧ conclusion ∉ M
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain actual checked witnesses. A finite model may contain extra truths beyond least closure; non-entailment refutes one implication and is not universal falsity.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: A valid model includes the requested premise and excludes its conclusion.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Refutes one universal implication; does not prove the conclusion always false.

formal_definitions.name: checkCountermodel
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
def checkCountermodel (T : Theory) (F M : List Atom) (premise conclusion : Atom) : Bool :=
  decide (Countermodel T F M premise conclusion)
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain actual checked witnesses. A finite model may contain extra truths beyond least closure; non-entailment refutes one implication and is not universal falsity.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Decides validity of the exact premise-present/conclusion-absent model.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Bind requested query and model identity rather than trusting a witness label.

formal_definitions.name: RequiredCountermodelSoundness
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev RequiredCountermodelSoundness : Prop :=
  ∀ (T : Theory) (F M : List Atom) (premise conclusion : Atom),
    checkCountermodel T F M premise conclusion = true →
    ¬ (∀ model : List Atom, Closed T F model → premise ∈ model → conclusion ∈ model)
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain actual checked witnesses. A finite model may contain extra truths beyond least closure; non-entailment refutes one implication and is not universal falsity.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: An accepted countermodel refutes the specified implication over Closed models.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Name the model class and exact premise/conclusion; do not upgrade to universal falsity.

formal_definitions.name: Old
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt: abbrev Old (base : Theory) (a : Atom) : Prop := a.predicate ∈ base.predicates.map Predicate.key
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain fixed-domain one-step old-body/fresh-head expansion as a special case. Recursion needs a new finite closure construction and every-old-model expansion proof.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Atom's exact predicate key belongs to the base vocabulary.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Preserve exact key/meaning rather than comparing only display names.

formal_definitions.name: RootPolicy
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev RootPolicy (T : Theory) (a : Atom) : Prop :=
  ∀ p ∈ T.predicates, p.key = a.predicate → rootedRole p.role = true → a.values ∈ T.roots
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain fixed-domain one-step old-body/fresh-head expansion as a special case. Recursion needs a new finite closure construction and every-old-model expansion proof.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Every rooted true atom has a tuple in the supplied root inventory.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Logical root provenance is separate from external authentication and observation sealing.

formal_definitions.name: SemanticModel
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev SemanticModel (T : Theory) (F : List Atom) (M : Atom → Prop) : Prop :=
  (∀ a, M a → AtomValid T a ∧ RootPolicy T a) ∧ (∀ a ∈ F, M a) ∧
  ∀ i, ValidInstance T i → (∀ a ∈ i.body, M a) → M i.head

-- These are finite structural/grounding assumptions, not conservativity as an
-- assumption. Captured instances must independently check every field.
formal_definitions.analysis: Old ordinary models may contain extra truths beyond initial projection. Existential view equality belongs to initial inventory, not arbitrary old models.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: All true atoms typed/root-respecting, contains seeds and is closed under valid instances.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Ordinary predicates may have extra truths; source-faithful sealed interpretations need a separate model class.

formal_definitions.name: FreshHeadExtension
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
structure FreshHeadExtension (base expanded : Theory) where
  fresh : List Predicate
  added : List GroundInstance
  domain_same : expanded.domain = base.domain
  predicates_append : expanded.predicates = base.predicates ++ fresh
  roots_same : expanded.roots = base.roots
  fresh_keys : ∀ p ∈ fresh, p.key ∉ base.predicates.map Predicate.key
  cover : ∀ i ∈ groundInstances expanded, i ∈ groundInstances base ∨ i ∈ added
  old_bodies : ∀ i ∈ groundInstances base, ∀ a ∈ i.body, Old base a
  added_bodies : ∀ i ∈ added, ∀ a ∈ i.body, Old base a
  fresh_heads : ∀ i ∈ added, ¬ Old base i.head
  head_typed : ∀ i ∈ added, AtomValid expanded i.head
  head_roots : ∀ i ∈ added, (∀ a ∈ i.body, RootPolicy base a) → RootPolicy expanded i.head
formal_definitions.analysis: added_bodies permits only old predicates. Recursive fresh bodies require a new contract; preserve old rules, facts, domain, roots and producer policy.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: A fixed-domain rule extension partitions old/fresh instances and allows only old bodies with fresh heads.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Positive recursion among fresh bodies needs a newly proved extension contract.

formal_definitions.name: expansion
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain fixed-domain one-step old-body/fresh-head expansion as a special case. Recursion needs a new finite closure construction and every-old-model expansion proof.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Old model truths plus fresh heads whose bodies already hold in the old model.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: One-step old-body expansion does not handle recursive fresh dependencies.

formal_definitions.name: RequiredRuleConservativity
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev RequiredRuleConservativity : Prop :=
  ∀ (base expanded : Theory), FreshHeadExtension base expanded →
    ∀ (F : List Atom) (M : Atom → Prop), SemanticModel base F M →
      ∃ expandedModel, SemanticModel expanded F expandedModel ∧
        ∀ a, Old base a → (expandedModel a ↔ M a)
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain fixed-domain one-step old-body/fresh-head expansion as a special case. Recursion needs a new finite closure construction and every-old-model expansion proof.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Every base semantic model expands without changing old atom truth.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: A concrete least-closure comparison is weaker than this universal requirement.

  base_valid : TheoryValid base

formal_definitions.boundary_question: Bind the appropriate certificate claim, not a shared display name.

formal_definitions.name: RefValid
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt: abbrev RefValid (r : Ref) : Prop := r.id ≠ "" ∧ r.version ≠ ""
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain the separately typed profile. Legacy qualifier strings need explicit source interpretations; known condition labels do not establish active or fulfilled obligations.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Reference id/version are nonempty.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Not source resolution or authenticity.

formal_definitions.name: PeriodValid
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt: abbrev PeriodValid (p : Period) : Prop := p.start < p.stop
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain the separately typed profile. Legacy qualifier strings need explicit source interpretations; known condition labels do not establish active or fulfilled obligations.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Start is strictly earlier than stop.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Equal endpoints are invalid; effectiveness separately uses inclusive start and exclusive stop.

formal_definitions.name: ClearAt
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev ClearAt (r : Option Nat) (epoch : Nat) : Prop :=
  match r with
  | none => True
  | some revoked => epoch < revoked
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain direct temporal/action/scope/gate checks and restriction monotonicity. Proposed-edge effectiveness and recorded representation are separate; permitted chains remain unknown.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: No revocation exists, or the evaluated epoch is strictly before revocation.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: The equality boundary is revoked; clock authenticity is outside the definition.

formal_definitions.name: EdgeMatches
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev EdgeMatches (e : ActsEdge) (d : Delegation) : Prop :=
  e.delegation = d.ref ∧ e.agent = d.agent ∧ e.principal = d.principal ∧
  e.period = d.period ∧ e.revokedAt = d.revokedAt
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain direct temporal/action/scope/gate checks and restriction monotonicity. Proposed-edge effectiveness and recorded representation are separate; permitted chains remain unknown.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Edge and delegation agree on exact identity/endpoints/period/revocation.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Action/scope effectiveness is checked elsewhere and must remain in the composed predicate.

formal_definitions.name: AllAccepted
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev AllAccepted (required : List Ref) (assessments : List Assessment) : Prop :=
  ∀ r ∈ required, ∃ a ∈ assessments, a.ref = r ∧ a.accepted = true
formal_definitions.analysis: Empty required gates are vacuously accepted. This is coherent unless a source requirement explicitly mandates a gate; avoid blind hardening.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Every required assessment reference has an accepted supplied row.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: An empty required list is intentionally vacuous; missing and rejected are different cases.

formal_definitions.name: AllResolved
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev AllResolved (required : List Ref) (assessments : List Assessment) : Prop :=
  ∀ r ∈ required, ∃ a ∈ assessments, a.ref = r
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain direct temporal/action/scope/gate checks and restriction monotonicity. Proposed-edge effectiveness and recorded representation are separate; permitted chains remain unknown.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Every required assessment reference has some supplied row.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Resolution alone does not establish acceptance.

formal_definitions.name: Effective
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev Effective (d : Delegation) (s : Snapshot) (e : ActsEdge)
    (action : String) (redelegated : Bool) : Prop :=
  EdgeMatches e d ∧ action ∈ d.actions ∧ e.scope ∈ d.scopes ∧
  d.period.start ≤ s.epoch ∧ s.epoch < d.period.stop ∧ ClearAt d.revokedAt s.epoch ∧
  AllAccepted d.policies s.policies ∧ AllAccepted d.gates s.gates ∧ redelegated = false
formal_definitions.analysis: No Recorded premise is intentional for a proposed-edge evaluation. Observed representation must additionally prove membership and source mapping.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Direct delegation matches, allows action/scope, is current and unrevoked, and all gates/policies are accepted.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: This evaluates a candidate; recorded representation requires a separate Recorded premise.

formal_definitions.name: Recorded
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt: abbrev Recorded (edges : List ActsEdge) (e : ActsEdge) : Prop := e ∈ edges
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain direct temporal/action/scope/gate checks and restriction monotonicity. Proposed-edge effectiveness and recorded representation are separate; permitted chains remain unknown.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: A supplied acts edge is present in a selected inventory.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Combine with Effective only when claiming an observed effective representation.

formal_definitions.name: RevocationRestricts
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev RevocationRestricts (narrow broad : Option Nat) : Prop :=
  match narrow, broad with
  | _, none => True
  | some n, some b => n ≤ b
  | none, some _ => False
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain direct temporal/action/scope/gate checks and restriction monotonicity. Proposed-edge effectiveness and recorded representation are separate; permitted chains remain unknown.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Narrow revocation occurs no later than broad revocation, handling none explicitly.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Retain exact direction for some/none and temporal-boundary cases.

formal_definitions.name: Restricts
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev Restricts (narrow broad : Delegation) : Prop :=
  narrow.agent = broad.agent ∧ narrow.principal = broad.principal ∧
  (∀ a ∈ narrow.actions, a ∈ broad.actions) ∧
  (∀ scope ∈ narrow.scopes, scope ∈ broad.scopes) ∧
  broad.period.start ≤ narrow.period.start ∧ narrow.period.stop ≤ broad.period.stop ∧
  RevocationRestricts narrow.revokedAt broad.revokedAt ∧
  (∀ p ∈ broad.policies, p ∈ narrow.policies) ∧
  (∀ gate ∈ broad.gates, gate ∈ narrow.gates)
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain direct temporal/action/scope/gate checks and restriction monotonicity. Proposed-edge effectiveness and recorded representation are separate; permitted chains remain unknown.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Same agent/principal with narrower actions/scopes/time/revocation and at least the required gates.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Subset structure preserves effectiveness direction, not issuer authorization.

formal_definitions.name: DelegationValid
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev DelegationValid (d : Delegation) : Prop :=
  RefValid d.ref ∧ RefValid d.agent ∧ RefValid d.principal ∧ PeriodValid d.period ∧
  (∀ s ∈ d.scopes, s ≠ "") ∧ d.scopes.Nodup ∧
  (∀ a ∈ d.actions, a ≠ "") ∧ d.actions.Nodup ∧
  (∀ p ∈ d.policies, RefValid p) ∧ d.policies.Nodup ∧
  (∀ g ∈ d.gates, RefValid g) ∧ d.gates.Nodup
formal_definitions.analysis: Empty actions/scopes can mean no effective authority. Define empty-list intent explicitly rather than requiring nonempty lists generically.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Checks delegation references, interval and unique well-formed value lists.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Empty action/scope lists can intentionally allow no effective action.

formal_definitions.name: ActsInventoryValid
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev ActsInventoryValid (ds : List Delegation) (s : Snapshot) (e : ActsEdge)
    (action : String) : Prop :=
  (∀ d ∈ ds, DelegationValid d) ∧ (ds.map Delegation.ref).Nodup ∧
  RefValid s.ref ∧ (∀ a ∈ s.policies, RefValid a.ref) ∧
  (s.policies.map Assessment.ref).Nodup ∧ (∀ a ∈ s.gates, RefValid a.ref) ∧
  (s.gates.map Assessment.ref).Nodup ∧ e.id ≠ "" ∧ RefValid e.agent ∧
  RefValid e.principal ∧ RefValid e.delegation ∧ e.scope ≠ "" ∧ PeriodValid e.period ∧ action ≠ ""
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain direct temporal/action/scope/gate checks and restriction monotonicity. Proposed-edge effectiveness and recorded representation are separate; permitted chains remain unknown.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Checks delegation uniqueness, snapshot assessment inventories and candidate edge/action shape.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Assessment uniqueness is per inventory; contextual identity needs its separate contract.

formal_definitions.name: DelegationResolved
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev DelegationResolved (ds : List Delegation) (e : ActsEdge) : Prop :=
  ∃ d ∈ ds, d.ref = e.delegation
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain direct temporal/action/scope/gate checks and restriction monotonicity. Proposed-edge effectiveness and recorded representation are separate; permitted chains remain unknown.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: An exact delegation reference appears in the supplied inventory.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Failure is unresolved interpretation, not a fabricated denial or default declaration.

formal_definitions.name: InterpretationKnown
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev InterpretationKnown (ds : List Delegation) (s : Snapshot) (e : ActsEdge) : Prop :=
  ∀ d ∈ ds, d.ref = e.delegation →
    AllResolved d.policies s.policies ∧ AllResolved d.gates s.gates
formal_definitions.analysis: Vacuously true with no matching delegation. Preserve the checker’s preceding DelegationResolved guard.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Required policy/gate references resolve for each matching delegation.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: With no matching delegation it is vacuously true; retain the preceding resolution guard.

formal_definitions.name: PermitsRedelegation
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev PermitsRedelegation (ds : List Delegation) (e : ActsEdge) : Prop :=
  ∃ d ∈ ds, d.ref = e.delegation ∧ d.redelegationAllowed = true
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain direct temporal/action/scope/gate checks and restriction monotonicity. Proposed-edge effectiveness and recorded representation are separate; permitted chains remain unknown.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: The matching declaration's chain-permission flag is true.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Permission to form a chain is not proof the presented chain is valid.

formal_definitions.name: ActsHolds
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev ActsHolds (ds : List Delegation) (s : Snapshot) (e : ActsEdge)
    (action : String) (redelegated : Bool) : Prop :=
  ∃ d ∈ ds, Effective d s e action redelegated
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain direct temporal/action/scope/gate checks and restriction monotonicity. Proposed-edge effectiveness and recorded representation are separate; permitted chains remain unknown.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Some supplied delegation makes this edge effective for the requested action.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: A result for one action/scope/snapshot cannot answer another query.

formal_definitions.name: Matches
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev Matches (e : Inheritance) (b : Binding) (c : Contract) : Prop :=
  e.binding = b.ref ∧ e.subject = b.subject ∧ e.contract = c.ref ∧
  c.ref ∈ b.contracts ∧ e.scope = b.scope ∧ e.scope = c.scope ∧
  e.condition = c.condition ∧ b.active = true ∧ b.overrides = [] ∧ c.interpreted = true
formal_definitions.analysis: Matching condition strings and interpreted=true do not evaluate the condition. ActiveNorm requires a separate exact holds assessment.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Inheritance, binding and contract agree exactly; binding active and contract interpreted, no overrides.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Condition-label equality is not condition activation.

formal_definitions.name: Origin
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev Origin (g : Graph) (f : Fact) : Prop :=
  f.edge ∈ g.inheritances ∧ ∃ b ∈ g.bindings, ∃ c ∈ g.contracts,
    Matches f.edge b c ∧ f.norm ∈ c.norms
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain exact origin and conformance independence. Distinguish potential inherited norms/conflicts, condition-activated obligations, and independently evidenced fulfillment.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: A member inheritance has exact matching binding/contract and a norm from that contract.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Retains provenance while asserting no condition truth or conformance.

formal_definitions.name: Derives
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
inductive Derives (g : Graph) : Fact → Prop where
  | propagate (f : Fact) (origin : Origin g f) : Derives g f
  | forward (f : Fact) (premise : Derives g f) : Derives g f
formal_definitions.analysis: Propagation and same-fact forward are already equivalent to Origin. This is not general hierarchy propagation or arbitrary Horn recursion.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Stress propagation from Origin or forwarding the same fact.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Equivalent to Origin; no new hierarchy traversal or norm transformation exists here.

formal_definitions.name: Conforms
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev Conforms (g : Graph) (e : Inheritance) : Prop :=
  ∃ a ∈ g.conformance, a.subject = e.subject ∧ a.contract = e.contract ∧
    a.scope = e.scope ∧ a.accepted = true
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain exact origin and conformance independence. Distinguish potential inherited norms/conflicts, condition-activated obligations, and independently evidenced fulfillment.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: There is an accepted stress conformance row matching subject, contract and scope.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Conformance is independent of inheritance and does not erase conflicts.

formal_definitions.name: BindingValid
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev BindingValid (b : Binding) : Prop :=
  RefValid b.ref ∧ RefValid b.subject ∧ b.scope ≠ "" ∧
  (∀ c ∈ b.contracts, RefValid c) ∧ b.contracts.Nodup ∧
  (∀ o ∈ b.overrides, RefValid o) ∧ b.overrides.Nodup
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain exact origin and conformance independence. Distinguish potential inherited norms/conflicts, condition-activated obligations, and independently evidenced fulfillment.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Checks binding/reference shape and distinct contract/override references.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: It does not by itself resolve all references or prove active truth.

formal_definitions.name: ContractValid
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev ContractValid (c : Contract) : Prop :=
  RefValid c.ref ∧ c.scope ≠ "" ∧ c.condition ≠ "" ∧
  (∀ n ∈ c.norms, n.action ≠ "") ∧ c.norms.Nodup
formal_definitions.analysis: Opposite require/forbid norms are allowed intentionally. Detect potential conflicts without invalidating the whole contract by default.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Checks reference, nonempty scope/condition and distinct nonempty-action norms.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Opposite norms can intentionally coexist and should be reported as conflict, not silently removed.

formal_definitions.name: InheritanceValid
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev InheritanceValid (e : Inheritance) : Prop :=
  e.id ≠ "" ∧ RefValid e.subject ∧ RefValid e.contract ∧ RefValid e.binding ∧
  e.scope ≠ "" ∧ e.condition ≠ ""
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain exact origin and conformance independence. Distinguish potential inherited norms/conflicts, condition-activated obligations, and independently evidenced fulfillment.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Checks inheritance ID, reference shapes and nonempty scope/condition.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Reference resolution and full matching are separate predicates.

formal_definitions.name: GraphValid
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev GraphValid (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  (∀ b ∈ g.bindings, BindingValid b) ∧ (g.bindings.map Binding.ref).Nodup ∧
  (∀ c ∈ g.contracts, ContractValid c) ∧ (g.contracts.map Contract.ref).Nodup ∧
  (∀ e ∈ g.inheritances, InheritanceValid e) ∧ (g.inheritances.map Inheritance.id).Nodup ∧
  (∀ a ∈ g.conformance, RefValid a.subject ∧ RefValid a.contract ∧ a.scope ≠ "")
formal_definitions.analysis: Conformance rows have no contextual key uniqueness or opposite-status rule. Choose a versioned assessment selection/conflict policy.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Stress bindings/contracts/inheritance records are well formed and identity-unique; conformance rows are shaped.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Conformance row contradictions are not excluded by this definition.

formal_definitions.name: InheritanceKnown
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev InheritanceKnown (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ g.inheritances, (∃ b ∈ g.bindings, b.ref = e.binding ∧ b.overrides = []) ∧
    ∃ c ∈ g.contracts, c.ref = e.contract ∧ c.interpreted = true
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain exact origin and conformance independence. Distinguish potential inherited norms/conflicts, condition-activated obligations, and independently evidenced fulfillment.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Each inheritance resolves to a binding without overrides and an interpreted contract.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Known interpretation does not activate the inherited norm.

formal_definitions.name: InheritanceMatches
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev InheritanceMatches (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ g.inheritances, ∃ b ∈ g.bindings, ∃ c ∈ g.contracts, Matches e b c
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain exact origin and conformance independence. Distinguish potential inherited norms/conflicts, condition-activated obligations, and independently evidenced fulfillment.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Every inheritance has a matching supplied binding/contract pair.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Matching is different from condition truth, conformance or fulfillment.

formal_definitions.name: ConflictPair
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev ConflictPair (f h : Fact) : Prop :=
  f.norm.mode = .require ∧ h.norm.mode = .forbid ∧ f.norm.action = h.norm.action ∧
  f.edge.subject = h.edge.subject ∧ f.edge.scope = h.edge.scope ∧
  f.edge.condition = h.edge.condition
formal_definitions.analysis: A potential same-condition conflict. Actual conflict additionally requires both activated norms in the exact evaluation context; permit does not erase conflict.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: A require/forbid pair agrees on action, subject, scope and condition label.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: It describes potential conflict; actual conflict additionally requires both active conditions.

formal_definitions.name: checkActs
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
def checkActs (ds : List Delegation) (s : Snapshot) (e : ActsEdge)
    (action : String) (redelegated : Bool) : Verdict :=
  if ¬ ActsInventoryValid ds s e action then .invalid
  else if ¬ DelegationResolved ds e then .unknown
  else if ¬ InterpretationKnown ds s e then .unknown
  else if redelegated = true ∧ PermitsRedelegation ds e then .unknown
  else if ActsHolds ds s e action redelegated then .yes else .no
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain the limited checker claims. Preflight expensive products; graph validity, requested-query evidence and completeness are composed obligations, not implied by every certificate.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Validates input, resolves interpretation, handles chain unknown, then evaluates direct effectiveness.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Preserve branch order and exact action/context; result is not recorded membership by itself.

formal_definitions.name: candidateFacts
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain the limited checker claims. Preflight expensive products; graph validity, requested-query evidence and completeness are composed obligations, not implied by every certificate.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Cartesian product of inheritances, contracts and their norms.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Preflight count before allocating; optimize matching only with correspondence evidence.

formal_definitions.name: closure
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
def closure (g : Graph) : List Fact :=
  ((candidateFacts g).filter fun f => decide (Origin g f)).eraseDups
formal_definitions.analysis: Potential-norm origin enumeration with deduplication, not arbitrary Horn saturation or checked condition activation.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Stress candidate facts filtered to exact Origins, then deduplicated.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: This is potential inherited-norm closure, not general Horn saturation or condition activation.

formal_definitions.name: conflicts
formal_definitions.analysis: Retain the limited checker claims. Preflight expensive products; graph validity, requested-query evidence and completeness are composed obligations, not implied by every certificate.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Enumerates Origin closure pairs satisfying the potential ConflictPair predicate.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Actual active conflict needs exact condition evaluation; resource bound must precede pair allocation.

formal_definitions.name: workUnits
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt: def workUnits (g : Graph) : Nat := (candidateFacts g).length + (closure g).length * (closure g).length
formal_definitions.analysis: Computes candidateFacts and closure before budget comparison. Introduce early upper bounds and measured stage time/work/allocation ceilings.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Candidate count plus square of exact stress closure size.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: Calculating it already computes closure; add a safe cheap bound before expensive allocation.

formal_definitions.name: checkInheritance
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
def checkInheritance (g : Graph) (budget : Nat) : Verdict :=
  if ¬ GraphValid g then .invalid
  else if ¬ InheritanceKnown g then .unknown
  else if ¬ InheritanceMatches g then .invalid
  else if workUnits g > budget then .unknown
  else .yes
formal_definitions.analysis: yes means bounded interpretation/matching checks passed. It does not mean conflict-free, conformant, activated or fulfilled.
formal_definitions.disposition: retain accepted meaning; add scoped contracts/controls where required
formal_definitions.meaning: Checks graph shape, interpretation and matching, then compares logical work budget.
formal_definitions.boundary_question: yes is not active/fulfilled/conflict-free; early resource checks must precede expensive work.

formal_definitions.name: StepShape
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
abbrev StepShape (steps : List Step) (s : Step) (i : Nat) : Prop :=
  match s.rule with
  | .propagate => s.parent = none
  | .forward => match s.parent with
    | none => False

def sameMeaning (a b : ConstantInfo) : Bool :=
  a.name == b.name && a.type == b.type && a.levelParams == b.levelParams &&
  a.value? (allowOpaque := true) == b.value? (allowOpaque := true) &&
  a.isUnsafe == b.isUnsafe && a.isPartial == b.isPartial &&

  | .thmInfo _, .thmInfo _ | .opaqueInfo _, .opaqueInfo _

formal_definitions.name: dependencies
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
partial def dependencies (env : Environment) (pending : List Name)
    (visited : NameSet := {}) (axioms : Array Name := #[]) : IO (NameSet × Array Name) := do
  match pending with
  | [] => return (visited, axioms)
  | n :: rest =>
    if visited.contains n then return ← dependencies env rest visited axioms
    let some ci := env.find? n | throw <| IO.userError s!"missing proof dependency {n}"
    if ci.isUnsafe || ci.isPartial then
      throw <| IO.userError s!"unsafe or partial proof dependency {n}"
    let mut next := rest
    for d in ci.getUsedConstantsAsSet do next := d :: next
    -- Replay of an inductive block also needs its mutual declarations and constructors.
    match ci with
    | .inductInfo info => next := info.all ++ info.ctors ++ next
    | .quotInfo _ => next := `Eq :: next
    | _ => pure ()
    let axioms := match ci with | .axiomInfo _ => axioms.push n | _ => axioms
    return ← dependencies env next (visited.insert n) axioms

formal_definitions.name: audit
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
unsafe def audit (expectedModule expectedName mode theoremName : String) : IO Json := do
  initSearchPath (← findSysroot)
  let objectFile ← findOLean `Submitted
  let mut files := #[objectFile]
  for level in [OLeanLevel.server, OLeanLevel.private] do
    let file := level.adjustFileName objectFile
    if ← file.pathExists then files := files.push file
  let parts ← readModuleDataParts files
  if parts.isEmpty then throw <| IO.userError "missing submitted module data"
  let allowedImports := #[`Init, `RelationalInput, `RelationalSemantics, `SemanticLogic,
    `RegistryChecker, `Preservation, `ConservativeExpansion, `InferenceCore,
    `DerivationSoundness, `ClosureAdequacy, `ProtectedLineage, `ModelSemantics,
    `RuleConservativity, `InferenceFixture]
  for part in parts do
    for imp in part.1.imports do
      if !allowedImports.contains imp.module then
        throw <| IO.userError s!"unapproved submitted import: {imp.module}"
  if !(parts.any fun part => part.1.constNames.contains theoremName.toName) then
    throw <| IO.userError "requested theorem is not declared by the submitted module"
  IO.eprintln "audit: load trusted declarations"
  let trusted ← importModules #[{module := expectedModule.toName}] {} 0 #[] false false
  IO.eprintln "audit: load submitted data without extensions"
  let submitted ← importModules #[{module := `Submitted}] {} 0 #[] false false
  let expectedName := expectedName.toName
  let theoremName := theoremName.toName
  let some expected := trusted.find? expectedName
    | throw <| IO.userError "trusted required statement does not exist"
  let expectedType ← match mode with
    | "definition-value" =>
      match expected with
      | .defnInfo info => pure info.value
      | _ => throw <| IO.userError "required proposition must be a trusted definition"
    | "theorem-type" =>
      match expected with
      | .thmInfo info => pure info.type
      | _ => throw <| IO.userError "required concrete type must belong to a trusted theorem"
    | _ => throw <| IO.userError "unsupported required statement mode"
  if (trusted.find? theoremName).isSome then
    throw <| IO.userError "submission theorem must be newly declared in the submitted module"
  let some (.thmInfo submittedThm) := submitted.find? theoremName
    | throw <| IO.userError "submitted identity is missing or is not a theorem"
  if !submittedThm.levelParams.isEmpty || !expected.levelParams.isEmpty then
    throw <| IO.userError "this catalog requires closed universe parameters"
  IO.eprintln "audit: collect trusted statement dependencies"
  let (expectedDependencies, _) ← dependencies trusted [expectedName, `propext, `Classical.choice, `Quot.sound]
  let mut checkedDefinitions := 0
  for n in expectedDependencies do
    let some ci := trusted.find? n | throw <| IO.userError s!"missing trusted definition {n}"
    let some actual := submitted.find? n
      | throw <| IO.userError s!"trusted declaration missing from submitted environment: {n}"
    if !sameMeaning ci actual then
      throw <| IO.userError s!"trusted declaration substituted: {n}"
    checkedDefinitions := checkedDefinitions + 1
  IO.eprintln s!"audit: compared {checkedDefinitions} trusted statement dependencies"
  let (_, axioms) ← dependencies submitted [theoremName]
  let allowed := #[`propext, `Classical.choice, `Quot.sound]
  for ax in axioms do
    if !allowed.contains ax then
      throw <| IO.userError s!"unapproved transitive axiom: {ax}"
  -- Reconstruct the submitted and imported pure declarations in an empty kernel.
  -- This uses the pinned Lean kernel, not a second independently implemented kernel.
  let (closure, _) ← dependencies submitted [theoremName, expectedName]
  let mut constants : Std.HashMap Name ConstantInfo := {}
  for n in closure do
    let some ci := submitted.find? n | throw <| IO.userError s!"missing replay declaration {n}"
    constants := constants.insert n ci
  IO.eprintln s!"audit: replay {constants.size} proof/type declarations"
  let fresh ← (← mkEmptyEnvironment).replay constants
  let exact : Declaration := .thmDecl {
    name := `ProofVerifierExactTypeCheck, levelParams := [], type := expectedType,
    value := mkConst theoremName }
  match fresh.toKernelEnv.addDeclCore 0 0 exact (cancelTk? := none) with
  | .error ex => throw <| IO.userError s!"exact required theorem type rejected: {← ex.toMessageData {} |>.toString}"
  | .ok _ => pure ()
  return Json.mkObj [
    ("schema", toJson "relational.independent-kernel-audit/v1"),
    ("accepted", toJson true), ("theorem_id", toJson theoremName.toString),
    ("required_statement", toJson expectedName.toString),
    ("statement_mode", toJson mode),
    ("transitive_axioms", toJson (axioms.map Name.toString)),
    ("trusted_definitions_checked", toJson checkedDefinitions),
    ("fresh_kernel_replay", toJson true),
    ("replayed_declarations", toJson constants.size),
    ("allowed_axiom_types_bound", toJson true),
    ("load_submitted_extensions", toJson false)]

formal_definitions.name: main
formal_definitions.definition_excerpt:
unsafe def main (args : List String) : IO UInt32 := do
  try
    match args with
    | [expectedModule, expectedName, mode, theoremName] =>
      let report ← audit expectedModule expectedName mode theoremName
      IO.println report.compress
      return 0
    | _ => throw <| IO.userError "expected module, required declaration, mode and theorem identity"
  catch error =>
    IO.eprintln s!"independent proof audit rejected: {error}"
    return 1

relations.controls: Scope declaration without issuer authentication/permission; no new inference root.

relations.unique_question: Which predecessor does this successor continue or replace?
relations.operational_effect: Records succession; replacement occurs only when succession_effect is supersedes.
relations.current_coverage: Source records succession and says replacement only when succession_effect is supersedes.
relations.gap: Generic strings do not interpret supersedes or execute lifecycle change; competing successors lack policy.
relations.proposed_improvement: Define succession-effect declaration meaning first; actual replacement requires checked lifecycle/currentness transition.
relations.controls: Non-superseding successor keeps predecessor current; competing supersedes need explicit policy.

relations.unique_question: Which exact Hypothesis is this Experiment Design constructed to test?
relations.operational_effect: Records only the named semantic connection with exact endpoints, qualifiers, evidence, owner, lifecycle, and claim ceiling.
relations.current_coverage: Hypothesis revision and test role are declared.
relations.gap: Design, execution and result are not separated; test does not establish truth.
relations.proposed_improvement: Bind exact hypothesis/test record with attempted/executed/result/evidence stages.
relations.controls: Planned/failed test cannot prove support; tested hypothesis can remain undecided.

relations.unique_question: Which Method does this subject depend on or employ?
relations.operational_effect: Records Method dependency without implying conformance, realization, or success.
relations.current_coverage: Method dependency/usage role is declared.
relations.gap: Use does not prove method compliance, realization, validation or achievement.
relations.proposed_improvement: Interpret usage role and independently assess compliance/outcome.
relations.controls: Method referenced but not followed; no validated result from use alone.

relations.unique_question: Which Tool or Implementation does this Agent Session or Agent Action use?
relations.operational_effect: Records only the named semantic connection with exact endpoints, qualifiers, evidence, owner, lifecycle, and claim ceiling.
relations.current_coverage: Tool revision, invocation contract and use role are declared.
relations.gap: Version/contract are unresolved and no successful execution/authority witness exists.
relations.proposed_improvement: Bind exact invocation contract/tool and separate execution receipt if claiming invocation.
relations.controls: Wrong tool/contract or failed invocation; no conformance/ownership from use.

relations.unique_question: Which exact expected boundary does evidence indicate was not satisfied?
relations.operational_effect: Records only the named semantic connection with exact endpoints, qualifiers, evidence, owner, lifecycle, and claim ceiling.
relations.current_coverage: Boundary revision and evidence posture are declared.
relations.gap: Declaration does not establish checked breach, severity or confirmed failure.
relations.proposed_improvement: Resolve exact boundary/scoped evidence; distinguish asserted and checked breach.
relations.controls: Wrong-boundary evidence or unconfirmed report; cause/severity remain absent.

proposed_definitions.name: MemberConformance
proposed_definitions.meaning: Inv(G), assertion membership and independent ConformsAt
proposed_definitions.required_boundary: A valid but unrecorded edge cannot support an observed fact.

proposed_definitions.name: ConformsTo
proposed_definitions.meaning: reference × reference × scope; exact assessment-backed member conformance
proposed_definitions.required_boundary: Sealed initial observation; no caller facts or rule heads.

proposed_definitions.name: TargetKind
proposed_definitions.meaning: reference × text; exact node kind through a checked vocabulary map
proposed_definitions.required_boundary: Independent sound/complete projection; kind text literal must be in captured domain.

proposed_definitions.name: ExistentialConformanceView
proposed_definitions.meaning: Unary Conforms matches rich observations in projected initial inventory
proposed_definitions.required_boundary: No new rule writing old Conforms; not equality for arbitrary old models.

proposed_definitions.name: SupportSet
proposed_definitions.meaning: Exact graph/assertion/assessment/profile witnesses for a deduplicated observation
proposed_definitions.required_boundary: Retain multiple supports; prove validity and source-support completeness.

proposed_definitions.name: ProducerPolicy
proposed_definitions.meaning: Sealed observations versus derived ordinary information, orthogonal to root Role
proposed_definitions.required_boundary: Every initial source and rule head authorized by exact selected profile.

proposed_definitions.name: RegisteredBaseline
proposed_definitions.required_boundary: Independently qualify before use; displayed version is not readiness.

proposed_definitions.name: BaselineTransition
proposed_definitions.meaning: Named richer-snapshot change with explicit fact/domain/assessment differences
proposed_definitions.required_boundary: Distinct from fixed-domain rule-only expansion; no reused incompatible receipts.

proposed_definitions.name: RecursiveFreshExtension
proposed_definitions.meaning: Fixed domain/roots/old rules/facts with positive fresh derived ordinary heads
proposed_definitions.required_boundary: Every-old-model expansion, finite stabilization, no unseeded facts.

proposed_definitions.name: EvaluationKey
proposed_definitions.meaning: Profile, condition revision, exact context/snapshot, relevant endpoints and epoch
proposed_definitions.required_boundary: Consistent selected status; evaluator/interpretation identity bound.

proposed_definitions.name: ConditionStatus
proposed_definitions.meaning: holds, does-not-hold, unknown; inconsistent selection gives conflict diagnostic
proposed_definitions.required_boundary: No absence-as-false; no contradictory evidence projects holds.

proposed_definitions.name: PotentialNorm
proposed_definitions.meaning: Inherited interpreted norm with exact Origin support
proposed_definitions.required_boundary: No claim of true condition, subject conformance or fulfillment.

proposed_definitions.name: ActiveNorm
proposed_definitions.meaning: PotentialNorm plus exact checked ConditionHolds in its context
proposed_definitions.required_boundary: False, unknown or mismatched context cannot activate; supplied truth explicit.

proposed_definitions.name: ActiveConflict
proposed_definitions.meaning: Active require and active forbid at same subject/action/scope/evaluation context
proposed_definitions.required_boundary: Separate potential conflict; permit neither erases conflict nor grants authority.

proposed_definitions.name: ClaimScope
proposed_definitions.required_boundary: No advertised guarantee beyond actually satisfied obligations.

proposed_definitions.name: ResourceEnvelope
proposed_definitions.meaning: Early conservative bounds and measured stage work/time/allocation ceilings
proposed_definitions.required_boundary: Exhaustion is unknown and blocks closure, absence and readiness.

proposed_definitions.name: SourceInterpretation
proposed_definitions.meaning: Exact qualifier/source/context-to-typed witness for a selected fragment
proposed_definitions.required_boundary: No guessed strings; extra fields mapped, assumed or explicitly unsupported.
